setlist_extra.title: Beat It On Down the Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Stands out with amazing jams according to the listener; First set songs are decent but not as luscious as November performances [10][15]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Features strong interplay between Phil and Keith, plus spacy wah-wah from Jerry [6]
- **Loser** (1 review): Characterized as slow and soulful in the first set [6]
- **Sing Me Back Home** (1 review): Jerry sings emotionally while Bobby and Donna sound like a gospel choir [7]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Long jam by Phil and Bill leads into a compact Dark Star [7]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Phil's harmonies in this song are called priceless [12]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Not short; preceding jam contains Dark Star themes throughout the track [13]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Listener realized they got lost in the jam before this song [17]
- Second performance since Pigpen's death on March 8th, described as poignant [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-24.139595.sbd.betty.composite.miller.clugston.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 231 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1973-03-24.170828.sbd.patched.001216.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 31 songs; 226 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Hamilton source sounds better than Betty Board, with more Phil presence [2]
- **gd73-03-24.sbd.bertha-ashley.25508.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 208 min; rated 4.7/5 by 60 [3]. Said about its sound: Mix is right and vocals are shining in this recording; Listener describes the recording as having perfect sound; Band sounds fluid, in sync, and almost like a studio recording [10][12][17]
- **gd73-03-24.sbd.hamilton.1216.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 218 min; rated 4.45/5 by 20 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording noted for nice quality and many highlights [8]
- **gd1973-03-24.sbd.cantor.deibert.83407.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 4.22/5 by 9 [5]

## Around the show

- Phil is on fire, Donna sounds decent, and Jerry is himself [16]
- Winter 1973 shows are favored, though this specific performance is worth downloading [8]
- Big Jam elevates show to best of early year, unlike later November versions [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-24.139595.sbd.betty.composite.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Primary Source: Betty's 10" MSR -> PCM -> DAT supplies the 2nd Set; Secondary Sources: MSR -> C -> DAT (gd73-03-24.sbd.hamilton.shnid1216) supplies the… [1]. Also: Betty Board has digital noise reduction; this transcription does not [1]
- **gd1973-03-24.170828.sbd.patched.001216.flegel.flac1644**: transferred by Brian Flegel; source: Patched soundboard [2]. Also: Hamilton cassette source from 2000 has better dynamics but track cuts [2]
- **gd73-03-24.sbd.bertha-ashley.25508.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Uploader lists full setlist including specific jam transitions and encores [3]
- **gd73-03-24.sbd.hamilton.1216.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1973-03-24.sbd.cantor.deibert.83407.sbeok.flac16**: source: 10" Betty Board Reel > PCM501ES > Fostex D5 (Jace's tape) optical S/PDIF out > disk [5]. Also: First reel unplayable due to mold and water damage causing distortion [5]
